title: Rademacher coordinate summand
statement: For a natural number $n$, an index $i$ among the $n$ coordinates, and a point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define the coordinate summand to be the normalized Rademacher coefficient in dimension $n$ multiplied by the sign of the $i$th coordinate of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a point of the sign cube on $n$ coordinates
